title: 第九章 凶残的boss

content_zh:
傲剑中华看着眼前的清风巡卫，脸上也是掩饰不住的兴奋，看这boss的架势，至少是白银级的boss吧！等干掉这个家伙会爆出什么装备，实在叫他期待不已！至于打不过什么的，完全不在他考虑中，在他想来，自己这个阵容十分强大，天霜城前20有6个在这里了，难道还搞不定区区一个boss？
要说傲剑这些人也真是倒霉了，他们中现在最高级的是19级，本来有20级的，被林铮干掉一次后就剩下19了，就这样，差了一级，探查不到boss的资料，于是也就低估了这个boss的实力，这也是悲剧的开始！
“甲士上！牧师盯好甲士的血！其他人给我狠狠地打！”傲剑中华大声喝道，颇有指点江山的气势，四个甲士在他的指挥下冲向了boss，并同时使用技能“叫阵”吸引仇恨，这样做有个好处，那就是混乱boss的仇恨目标，一定程度上能降低boss的攻击频率。他们这一招奏效了，boss一时不知道该攻击哪个目标，而这时候，傲剑的攻击铺天盖地而来，火球冰弹闪电箭矢，近战职业的刀枪剑斧，全部落到了boss的身上，然后便是让傲剑的人目瞪口呆的伤害一个个冒出，-25、-30、-100、-56、-45……超过100的伤害没几个，而且都是法师造成的。而没等傲剑的人回过神来，boss发飙了！
“吼！——”boss发出一声咆哮，那是震耳欲聋，让人都忍不住捂住了耳朵，然后包围着boss的傲剑成员骇然发现，自己的气血200点每秒地狂掉，傲剑中华也在此中，立刻大喊起来：“牧师！加！赶紧加啊！”远处的牧师也顾不得咆哮声了，赶紧挥起法杖加血，可惜牧师也就四个人，而围攻boss的可是有十几个人啊！完全加不过来，然后，好几个脆皮点的就这么悲剧地在boss五秒的咆哮中耗尽气血倒地了！好不容易撑过了boss的咆哮，傲剑的人刚松了口气，正想重新组织攻势，没想到boss再次咆哮了一声，吓得他们心都提起来了！结果发现气血没有掉，围攻的人再次松了口气的同时也忍不住大骂，靠了，没事叫什么叫啊！吓死人了！
“跑！快跑啊！”远战的的傲剑成员叫道，近战的没发现，他们可是发现了，boss咆哮了那一下之后双眼都发出了红光，按照他们的经验来说，几乎可以确定boss刚刚是用来什么强化技能，这个样子，攻击绝对是提升了不少！可惜他们发现的还是有点晚了，boss挥起斧头朝一个甲士就是一下，-1125，巨大的伤害一下子从甲士头上冒了出来，甲士被秒杀。
“咝——”躲在一边的林铮几人倒吸了以后凉气，这伤害也太变态了！狂暴！没错，林铮已经探查出来了，狂暴状态下，boss的攻击上升了一倍，不过防御倒是掉了75%，只是在boss的这个状态下，防御什么的已经不重要了，一斧头秒杀一个，谁又能在它气血掉光之前活下来呢？
“这个死变态，这可怎么杀啊！”龙牙目瞪口呆地盯着已经秒杀了好几个人的boss道。
“黄金boss呢！你以为那么好杀的啊！估计得全身白银装备杀起来才好点！”春风分析道，“现阶段基本都是白装，我看啊，这boss是没人杀得了了！”
“唔！——也不一定！”林铮盯着boss许久后说道，他现在有个大概的方案，不过操作起来有些难度，就怕几人技术不过关！于是他想到了某人！
“我认识个家伙，叫红尘烟雨，叫过来帮忙不？”林铮问道，毕竟这boss现在是他们一队人发现的，林铮想叫人来，按规矩可是得征求几人的同意。
“红尘烟雨！？”几人有点吃惊，这货可是排行榜前五的牛人啊！
“嗯！”林铮点了点头，“这货现在和我住一块！人品的话，没的说！怎么样？”
“既然神棍你认识，倒是无所谓了，不过就算来了，这个死变态就能打得过了吗？”霸王指着已经差不多将傲剑全灭的boss道。此时傲剑的近战人员已经全部阵亡，远程的也死得差不多了，现在boss正在追杀一个神箭手，一斧头下去，神箭手也惨叫着被秒杀了。

content_en:
Aojian Zhonghua looked at the Qingfeng patrol in front of him, and couldn't hide the excitement on his face. Judging from the posture of this boss, he must be at least a silver-level boss! He can't wait to see what equipment will be revealed when he kills this guy! As for being unable to defeat him, that was not something he considered at all. When he thought about it, his lineup was very strong. Six of the top 20 players in Tianshuang City were here. Could it be that he still couldn't defeat a mere boss?
Speaking of people like Ao Jian, they are really unlucky. The highest level among them is now level 19. There were originally level 20, but after being killed once by Lin Zheng, only 19 was left. Just like that, one level was missing, and the boss's information could not be detected, so he underestimated the strength of this boss. This was also the beginning of the tragedy!
"Enter the soldier! Priest, keep an eye on the blood of the soldier! Beat me hard for the others!" Aojian Zhonghua shouted loudly, with the momentum of pointing the country. Under his command, the four soldiers rushed towards the boss, and at the same time used the skill "Calling Formation" to attract hatred. This has the advantage of confusing the boss's hatred target, which can reduce the frequency of the boss's attacks to a certain extent. Their move worked, and the boss didn't know which target to attack. At this time, Ao Jian's attacks came overwhelmingly. Fireballs, ice bombs, lightning arrows, and melee professional swords, guns, swords, and axes all fell on the boss. Then, the damage that stunned the people of Ao Jian appeared one after another, -25, -30, -100, -56, -45... There were very few damages exceeding 100, and they were all caused by mages. But before Ao Jian's man could recover, the boss went berserk!
"Roar! -" The boss let out a roar that was so deafening that people couldn't help but cover their ears. Then the members of Aojian who surrounded the boss were shocked to find that their blood was losing 200 points per second. Aojian China was also among them, and they immediately shouted: "Priest! Come on! Come on!" The priest in the distance ignored the roar and hurriedly waved his staff to increase the health. Unfortunately, there were only four priests, but there were more than a dozen people surrounding the boss! It was completely impossible to add more, and then, tragically, several squishy ones fell to the ground after exhausting their energy and blood during the boss's five-second roar! After finally surviving the boss's roar, Ao Jian's people just breathed a sigh of relief and were about to reorganize their offensive. Unexpectedly, the boss roared again, which scared them to the point of being scared! It turned out that the blood and energy had not been lost. The besiegers breathed a sigh of relief again and couldn't help but cursed, "Damn it, what are you saying when you're fine!" It’s so scary!
"Run! Run!" The Aojian members who were fighting in the distance shouted. Those in the close combat didn't notice it, but they noticed it. After the boss roared, his eyes glowed red. According to their experience, it was almost certain that the boss had just used some kind of enhanced skill. In this way, the attack was definitely improved a lot! Unfortunately, they discovered it a bit late. The boss swung his ax at a soldier, -1125, huge damage suddenly appeared from the soldier's head, and the soldier was killed instantly.
"Hiss——" Lin Zheng and others who were hiding aside gasped, the damage was too abnormal! violent! That's right, Lin Zheng has already found out. In the violent state, the boss's attack doubled, but the defense dropped by 75%. However, in this state of the boss, defense is no longer important. If one is killed with an axe, who can survive before it loses all its energy and blood?
"How can you kill this pervert?" Long Ya stared at the boss who had already killed several people in a blink of an eye.
"Where's the golden boss? Do you think it's so easy to kill? I guess it would be better to kill it with all silver equipment!" Chunfeng analyzed, "At this stage, it's basicallyWhite outfit, let me see, no one can kill this boss! "
"Hmm! ——Not necessarily! " Lin Zheng stared at the boss for a long time and said. He now has a rough plan, but it is a bit difficult to operate. He is afraid that a few people are not skilled enough! So he thought of someone!
"I know a guy named Hongchen Yanyu, can I call him over to help? Lin Zheng asked. After all, this boss was discovered by a group of them. If Lin Zheng wanted to call someone, according to the rules, he had to ask for the consent of several people.
"The world is full of mist! ? "A few people were a little surprised. This guy is one of the top five in the rankings!
"Hmm! Lin Zheng nodded, "This guy lives with me now!" As for character, nothing to say! How about it? "
"Since you know the magic stick, it doesn't matter, but even if it comes, can you beat this pervert? "Overlord pointed at the boss who had almost wiped out Aojian. At this time, all the melee personnel of Aojian were dead, and almost all the long-range ones were dead. Now the boss was chasing a sharp archer. With an axe, the sharp archer screamed and was instantly killed.
